title: Bulk changes and its Build new forms, the POV, fleet, Beacon, bypass, detection health and Path analyzer scripts, the browser, posture, shadow and flow pages, and the browser extension: typed confirmation, keyboard and focus, escaping, plain errors, reflow, HAR caps, extension CSP

coverage.method: V8 precise block coverage in headless Chromium (CDP Profiler), mean line coverage over the 15 owned scripts and 9 owned pages; before = every owned page loaded (what the existing browser tests exercise), after = plus the tests/test_c6_ui_ops.py driver. Build new forms: ops_aiguard 12.3->87.7, ops_zcc 9.2->98.3, ops_zdx 6.1->98.9, ops_zia_baseline 7.5->89.5, ops_zpa 12.8->94.7; report_operations 19.2->69.1; bypass_report 1.8->78.4; detection_health 5.2->39.2. Block (branch) coverage mean 22.8->44.1. har_parse.js and path_modules.js are also run under node by tests/test_har_import.py and tests/test_path_zia_modules.py, which this browser measure does not count.

checks.what: Bulk changes: the typed phrase is shown and Apply stays disabled until it matches (case-insensitive, look-alikes refused, as the server compares)
Bulk changes: Apply also waits for write mode, a ready plan, the assessor's name and the review box; undoing any gate disarms it
Bulk changes: page and server phrase comparison agree on an oracle table (14 cases incl. NFC, long s, full-width, dotless i)
Typed phrase, review box and cursor survive a window focus (write-mode re-check)
Focus after Apply (the outcome) and after Undo (the Undo plan)
Apply form operable by keyboard alone (Tab order, Space on the box, Enter on Apply)
Undo previews first, is marked Undo, starts disarmed and sends undo_of
Form values reach the API as typed (unicode, markup) and the applied spec is the previewed one
Tenant names, labels, warnings in the pick list and preview are text
Builder scripts load once each; a plugin entry with a bad type or script name is ignored
Every Build new form (ZIA baseline, SSL certificates, ZPA x4, ZCC x2, ZDX x3, AI Guard x2) rendered from crafted data: markup as text, no javascript: links, each validation message, the spec sent
ZPA enrollment count goes to the server as typed (0 and 501 refused there, never a silent 5)
One-time provisioning key shown in a read-only field as a value; a refusal reads as words
No owned page shows '[object Object]' for a FastAPI list or object detail
Bypass report escapes rule ids and counts
Bypass report draws at most 500 rows and 6 references per row
Client Connector fleet page fits 320px
Install command builder withdraws Copy/Download after the form changes
Install builder secrets are password fields and masked by the server unless revealed; nothing stored
Detection health stricter-for-users approval: phrase is a visible label, Approve disabled until exact
Server numbers interpolated into HTML (fleet, detection health, bypass) are escaped
Beacon and POV links built from data are https only
Path analyzer list download/show URLs encode their query values
HAR file over 100 MB, empty, invalid JSON, no log, no entries refused in words (existing tests)
HAR: distinct hosts tracked capped at 20000, hosts listed as left out capped at 1000 with a total, body sizes capped so sums stay finite
HAR: only host names and counts leave the browser; file name and contents do not (existing tests and code review)
Path analyzer page shows the total of hosts left out (more_total) rather than the capped list length
Extension background accepts names/focus only from console tabs and index-updated only from its own pages; content script only from the extension
Extension permissions: activeTab, contextMenus, scripting, sidePanel, storage; host permissions loopback only; console origins optional
Extension app address accepted only on the origins its CSP and host_permissions allow
Extension pages CSP: default-src 'self', form-action 'none'; no inline style
Badge text set as textContent in a closed shadow root; a finding without text still labels
Every style token the extension uses is defined (options field border)
Extension keeps the index in session storage (cleared on browser close), the app address in sync storage, no credential
Popup, side panel and options load under the CSP, fit 320px and are reachable by Tab
All owned pages at 320px on the sample tenant, every Build new form read and previewed at 320px: no sideways scroll, no console error
Bulk changes end to end on the sample tenant: read, pick, preview, apply, read back, history, Undo preview
Shared sink allow-lists and the standards document follow the escaping changes

findings.title: Bulk changes Apply was enabled before the typed phrase, the review box or the assessor were given, and the page's phrase check (toUpperCase) accepted look-alikes the server refuses
findings.fix: Apply is disabled until every gate is met; phraseMatches mirrors security.typed_phrase_matches; the phrase is shown in bold

findings.title: A window focus redrew the Bulk changes apply form, erasing the typed phrase, the review tick and the keyboard focus
findings.fix: Redraw only when write mode changed; a redraw of the same plan keeps the phrase, the box and the focus

findings.title: Bypass report wrote tenant rule ids and counts into HTML unescaped (a crafted snapshot ran script)
findings.fix: Escape every id and count; also cap the aggregated lists at 500 rows and 6 references

findings.title: Bypass report drew every aggregated item (tens of thousands after category expansion) in one innerHTML write
findings.fix: Draw the first 500 rows with 6 references each and say how many more the export has

findings.title: Client Connector fleet page scrolled sideways at 320px (install builder fields), failing the existing reflow test on this branch
findings.fix: Install builder labels wrap and inputs shrink to the line

findings.title: Error details from FastAPI (a 422 list or an object) showed as '[object Object]' on 11 owned pages
findings.fix: A per-page errText helper words string, {cause} and list details

findings.title: Extension accepted an https or [::1] app address that its CSP connect-src and host_permissions block, so the setting saved and never answered
findings.fix: normalizeAppUrl accepts only http on 127.0.0.1 or localhost, the origins the manifest allows

findings.title: ZPA connector group form sent 5 when the enrollment count was typed as 0 (Number(x) || 5), hiding the user's value
findings.fix: Send a whole number as typed and anything else as text, so the server refuses it in words; blank stays 5

findings.title: HAR parser kept every distinct host and listed every host over the cap, so a capture with hundreds of thousands of hosts filled memory and the DOM; a huge bodySize made the sums Infinity
findings.fix: Track at most 20000 hosts (count the rest), list at most 1000 left out with more_total, cap a body at the file size

findings.title: Each builder script was added to Bulk changes once per type it serves (ops_zpa.js four times)
findings.fix: Load each script name once

findings.title: Keyboard focus fell to the page after Apply and after Undo (their buttons are removed)
findings.fix: Focus the outcome card after Apply and the plan heading after Undo

findings.title: Beacon links from watched pages and the run history were linked whatever their scheme
findings.fix: safeHref links only https addresses (also on the POV kit links)

findings.title: Detection health's stricter-for-users approval showed its phrase only as a placeholder and left Approve enabled
findings.fix: The phrase is a visible label; Approve is disabled until the exact phrase is typed

findings.title: Install command builder kept offering Copy and Download of the last command after the form changed
findings.fix: A change to the form withdraws the command until it is built again

findings.title: A refused provisioning key showed '[object Object]'
findings.fix: Word a string or {cause} detail, else the HTTP status

findings.title: Extension pages' CSP had no default-src, so images, styles, frames and form targets were not restricted
findings.fix: default-src 'self' and form-action 'none'; the options page's inline style moved to options.css

findings.title: Extension options page used an undefined style token (--line), so the address field had no border
findings.fix: Use --border-strong

findings.title: Path analyzer's HAR note counts the hosts left out as more.length, which is now capped at 1000; it should show more_total and the untracked count
findings.fix: Use more_total and untracked in moreNote (static/report_path.html, not in this slice)
